questions.question: Please provide an overview of your company, including founding date, headcount, primary service areas, and relevant certifications (e.g. ISO 27001, Microsoft Gold Partner).
Describe your experience delivering AI and data platform solutions to mid-market enterprise clients in the Benelux or DACH region. Please include at least two relevant reference projects.
What is your company's approach to data privacy and GDPR compliance in the context of AI systems that process sensitive commercial documents?
Describe your proposed technical architecture for the AI-powered RFP response platform. Include details on the retrieval mechanism, language model selection, and document generation pipeline.
How does your solution ensure that generated proposal content is grounded in TechCorp's actual knowledge base and does not produce hallucinated or fabricated content?
